ex.en: I have to get off at the next stop.
While getting off the bus, she heard her name called.
ex.zh: 她一下車，就聽到有人叫她的名字。

ex.en: Don't get off the train till it stops.
We saw the child get on the bus.
We happened to get on the same bus.
ex.zh: 我們剛好搭上同一班公車。

ex.en: He is a man hard to get on with.
ex.zh: 他是個很難相處的男人。

ex.en: I get on well with my roommate.
